protocol.reference: minimum positive recorded last price in prior six hours, excluding current quote
protocol.crossing: current >= 1.05*reference and previous < the same frozen threshold
protocol.hot_link: earliest original HOT recorded in preceding six hours; excludes event quote
protocol.unknown: missing baseline, gaps and unavailable original HOT records stay unclassified
protocol.scope: all positive-price markets in verified cached ticker/run pairs; no photo selection
protocol.interpretation: first sampled threshold crossing, not true pump onset, execution or intrabar high
